content.comment_body: I have the [version_no] demo installed (DVD and [product_name] ordered), how can I start [product_name] Web Editor?
[product_name] Web Editor is a separate software, not included in [product_name] Soft Comfort. You need to download it separately.

I read somewhere that [product_name] Web Editor is part of [product_name] Soft Comfort since [version_no]. I have [version_no] so assumed it was already included. However, I found it in the download folder of [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], thanks.

[product_name] Web Editor [version_no] is included in the download for SP1 of [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. Although it's part of the download package, it remains a separate software program.

analysis.insight_summary: There is uncertainty among users about whether [product_name] Web Editor is integrated into [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. The expectation was that [product_name] Web Editor could be accessed directly after installation. Clarification revealed that while it is distributed with [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] SP1, it operates as its own program and must be launched separately.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] Web Editor to be natively integrated into [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] and easily accessible after installation.
